|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Commander Luke Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-commanderlukeskywalker-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-commanderlukeskywalk022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114022426/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch5-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Commander Luke Skywalker”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Commander Luke Skywalker (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-commanderlukeskywalkab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Commander Luke Skywalker”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots.
